unit.why: A short anecdote: the tsaddik refuses to make kiddush on a sealed bottle, sensing it is not wine, and it turns out to be mead from Hungary.

stories.summary_en: When wine was brought to the tsaddik for kiddush in a sealed bottle, he looked at it, would not make kiddush on it because he saw no 'wine aspect' on it, and when it was opened after kiddush it turned out to be honey-water (mead) from Hungary.

quotes: ואמר שלא ראה עליו ענין יין
לשים עיניו על היין כשהוא בכלי
tags.why: He perceives the contents of a sealed bottle

quotes: ולא רצה לקדש עליו וקידש על יין
tags.why: Whether the drink is fit for kiddush
